description: A Perl script for extracting and displaying target, architecture, kernel, and device information from build system makefiles, with functions to parse target info and device info, and command-line interface for querying data.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from make command output for a given target directory and subtarget.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device information from make command output for a given target directory and subtarget.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target makefiles to gather target, subtarget, and feature info.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device info for a specified target/subtarget.
